descriptionChirho: A single person characterized by covenant faithfulness and piety toward God, used as a substantive adjective for an individual devotee or saint.
The collective body of God's faithful people, His covenant community of saints, always plural and typically with possessive suffixes referring to God or an addressee.
Used as a predicate adjective describing God Himself as gracious, merciful, and kind — the source of chesed rather than its human practitioner.
